vacancyList.postName: Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders)

howToApply: Candidates must first register on the respective NAPS/NATS Portal based on their trade: For Trade Apprentice (DEO/DDEO): https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in; For Technician Apprentice and Trade Apprentice (HR/Accountant): https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php

Login to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using User ID/Email ID and apply for the apprenticeship openings using the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Pipelines Division) for the relevant region.

After applying on NAPS/NATS Portal, visit the Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ and complete Part-I registration by filling basic details (name, category, etc.) and creating a password. Note the system-generated registration number sent to your email/SMS.

Login again with the registration number and password to complete Part-II registration: upload scanned colour photograph (20-50 KB, JPG) and signature in black ink (10-30 KB, JPG), and furnish educational qualification and experience details.
Submit the application. After final submission, details cannot be changed. Take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
Ensure the same e-mail ID and mobile number used in NAPS/NATS Portal are used in the Indian Oil Pipelines portal.
The application window is from 06.11.2026 to 05.12.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

title: NICL Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: NICL has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduation (Regular – Full time). Last date to apply: 18-11-26.
howToApply: Visit the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in/index.php
If already enrolled (Category A): Login with your email ID and password, search for ‘NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LTD’ under ‘Apply against advertised vacancies’, and click Apply.
If first-time enrollment (Category B): Click Student > Regular Student > Student Registration, complete the application form, and obtain your 12-digit unique Enrollment Number.
Upload required documents: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark Sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, and latest Passport-size Photograph.
Ensure percentage of marks is compulsorily entered in the column ‘% of marks / CGPAx10’ in the NATS portal.
Candidates can apply for engagement in ONE STATE only.
Ensure 100% complete profile on the NATS portal before applying.
Submit the application before 18.11.2026.

title: Indian Bank Recruitment 2026 – Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: Indian Bank has announced notification for Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline. Last date to apply: 25-11-26.

dates.event: Opening Date for Online Registration & Payment of Application Fees
Closing Date for Online Registration & Payment of Application Fees

howToApply: Register on the NATS 2.0 Portal (www.nats.education.gov.in) before applying. Only candidates who passed graduation on or after 1st April 2022 need to register here. Ensure 100% complete profile on the portal.
Note down the Enrolment ID generated in NATS 2.0 Portal for future correspondence.
Visit the Bank’s website www.indianbank.bank.in and click on the Careers page or visit https://www.nats.education.gov.in and click on ‘Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank – 2026’.
Click on ‘Click here for New Registration’, enter Name, contact details and email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated.
Fill in the application form. Use ‘SAVE AND NEXT’ to save data if unable to complete in one go.

Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20KB–50KB), signature (black ink on white paper, 10KB–20KB), left thumb impression (20KB–50KB), and handwritten declaration (50KB–100KB) as per specifications in Annexure-II.
Preview and verify all details before clicking ‘COMPLETE REGISTRATION’.
Proceed to the ‘Payment’ tab and pay the application fee online using Debit/Credit Card or Internet Banking.
On successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and online application form for future reference.
Do NOT send the printout to the Bank.
